comment: task recipe-data-b2c-roll - the ClusterMill handler static expansion. Row source: RM.ClusterMill.add(RecipeMapHandlerPrefix) x2, Loader_Recipes_Handlers.java:309 (hard leg) + :311 (easy leg), both plate 1 -> foil 4, eut 16, And(ANTIMATTER.NOT, SMITHABLE, easyWorkable) with easyWorkable = FURNACE|SOFT (Loader_Recipes_Handlers.java:58 Or(TD.Processing.FURNACE, TD.Properties.SOFT)). Engine: RecipeMapHandlerPrefix is query-time lazy per material - addRecipesUsing/Producing (:135-146) gate on the material condition (:205) and input/output item existence (:209/:214); addAllRecipesInternal (:170-178) walks mInputPrefixes[0].mRegisteredMaterials. Duration: easy leg mDuration=16 fixed; hard leg mDuration=0 -> getCosts (:225-227) = UT.Code.units(U, U, multiplier*(mToolQuality+1), T) = 256*(toolQuality+1) exactly (plate U = foil 4 x U4 = U, no rounding remainder). DECLARED DEVIATION (handler semantics -> JSON static rows): the handler generates lazily against the LIVE material universe at query time; this file is the frozen port universe snapshot (GTMaterialItems.registrationOrder, plate-prefix members with both plate and foil items, minus ANTIMATTER / not-SMITHABLE / INVALID_MATERIAL) - the craftfrom 962-row precedent of the same deviation class. New plate/foil registrations need a re-pour or the JSON trails the live walk (the GT6RecipeMapDataB2cRollRowsPourTest live-walk cross-check pins this file against the live registration and fails when they drift). REPLACED SMOKE ROW: the p29-w1 row (plate_iron -> foil_iron x2, duration 32, "riding the RollingMill row shape") was semantically wrong against the handler (upstream count 4, iron NEVER_FURNACE+not-SOFT = hard leg -> 256*(2+1)=768); the full expansion below supersedes it. Row census: 87 easy + 220 hard = 307 rows.
